function: Learned joint channel allocation, transmit-power selection (VU agents) and IRS phase-shift configuration (SBS agent) to maximize V2I sum rate under jamming (pp. 3, 6).
system: Single-antenna VUs; scalar uplink channels to SBS; reflecting passive IRS, L=12 elements; one jammer, 5 PU channels; 2 GHz, 1 MHz (Table I, p. 9).
method: Heterogeneous multi-agent Transformer-enhanced dueling double DQN (HMA-TD3QN); reinforcement learning, centralized training with decentralized execution; 2000 training episodes (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulated channels: path loss 128.1+37.6log10(d), log-normal shadowing, exponential small-scale fading, IRS array responses, outdated CSI by Bessel-J0 correlation; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4-5, 9).
test_conditions: Table I training setup (4 VUs, 5 PUs, 12 IRS elements, 2000 episodes). Evaluation sweeps IRS elements, jamming power, PUs, speed, VUs; no unseen-condition test stated (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Learned: HMA-D3QN [42], HMA-DDQN [43], HMA-DQN. Non-learned: random IRS phase with random resource allocation; no IRS with random resources (Fig. 6) (pp. 9-10).
metrics: Sum V2I rate, per-VU average rate, Jain's fairness index, convergence over episodes, running time for 100 episodes (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Order C_HMA = O(Ne*Ns*(I+1)*C_T), C_T being the Transformer-network cost (p. 9); runtime for 100 episodes 64.19 s versus 44.92, 36.69, 36.33 s (Table III, p. 12).
q1_support: p. 4: "gi,S is the small-scale fading power component, which is independent and exponentially distributed with unit mean". Custom simulator (path loss, log-normal shadowing, exponential fading; Table I, p. 9); no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 10: "we compare the proposed HMA-TD3QN and benchmark schemes under different parameters of the considered system". Only parameter sweeps (IRS elements, jamming power, PUs, speed, VUs) in one simulator; the paper never states testing on a condition unseen in training or after adaptation.
q3_support: p. 9: "the following benchmark schemes: HMA-D3QN [42], HMA-DDQN [43], HMA-DQN and the random phase shift with random resource allocation"; p. 10: "our proposed HMA-TD3QN method has a 24.42%, 20.79%, and 22.25% increase in the sum V2I rate" over HMA-DQN.
q4_support: p. 9: complexity "O (Ne Ns (I + 1) CT )" for the proposed method; p. 12: "Table III presents the running time of different algorithms under smart jamming scenarios" (64.19 s for HMA-TD3QN).
q5_support: p. 9: "The experiments were conducted using Python 3.9" on its own simulated DRL environment; no code or data link, DOI or availability statement appears, and channels are simulated, not a public dataset.
notes: Included as area 3: the SBS agent learns the IRS phase shift (p. 3, p. 6) jointly with VU channel and power allocation; the setting is anti-jamming, which alone is an excluded function, so the reviewer may confirm the area-3 reading. HMA-D3QN is the proposed method without the Transformer, so q3 rests on HMA-DQN, HMA-DDQN and the random baseline. The Table I path loss 128.1+37.6log10(d) is not attributed to 3GPP in the paper.
